The dispute items do not belong to me. Im attaching the required FTC Report for you and the bank 's records. Please block/remove these items.

title: Collector chasing a stranger's apartment debt
complaint:
Someone in XXXX used my identity and rented apartment in washington DC area and left that apartment company with a balance of {$1000.00}. I had left XXXX on XXXX XXXX, XXXX to XXXX after selling my house on XXXX XXXX, XXXX in XXXX XXXX Michigan, Since then I have become permanent resident of XXXX and I presently work here also in XXXX, XXXX. 

this company said in order for me to take my name away from their call list they need me to file a formal report to CFPB and police. But Michigan police said I need to come in person to file the report as they don't except online complaints. 

Hence, I hereby request you to please help me in this regard. I have XXXX credit score and presently have business in Michigan and own a house too.

answer.issue: Collector demanding payment on identity theft rental debt

title: Bank froze my checking and savings money
complaint: Called Capital one bank in early XX/XX/2023 and requested the release of the funds in checking AND savings. Total {$1600.00} Was told that it was under investigation for " fraud '' and would take 90 days for the investigation. Called XX/XX/XXXX ( 90 days ) to request status of the refund and was told " 7-10 business days '' to release the money. Called again on XX/XX/XXXX and was told, again, " 7-10 business days to close the account and release the funds ''. Capital One Bank has been holding MY money for over 5 months. I want the money refunded.

answer.issue: Bank holding funds in checking and savings for months
answer.summary: The customer requested release of $1,600 from their Capital One checking and savings accounts, was repeatedly told the funds were under fraud investigation with vague timelines, and says the money has been held for over five months.

answer.issue: Funds held in checking and savings
answer.summary: Capital One has held $1,600 in the complainant’s checking and savings accounts for over five months after a fraud investigation and has not released the funds as promised.

answer.summary: The bank has been holding the consumer's checking and savings funds for over five months under a fraud investigation without releasing the money.

title: Card dispute denied for charms never delivered
complaint: On XX/XX/XXXX I ordered some charms through XXXX. The charms were not delivered and I requested a refund for all the items. Since XXXX was taking too long to provide the refund I contacted my bank and requested a dispute. On XX/XX/, Citibank denied the dispute based on what XXXX claims is a venue made up of independent sellers. But on XXXX XXXX XXXX  XXXX agreed to refund the amount of the purchase but the credit never went through supposedly because I was disputing the charges with my bank. I have letters proving my claim. The original amount purchased was {$300.00}, but they did refund me back {$220.00} and I'm still missing {$73.00}. XXXX is stating that they can't provide me with the credit due to the bank dispute.

answer.issue: Refund not received after disputed online purchase
answer.summary: The consumer ordered charms that were never delivered, disputed the charge with their bank, and received only part of the $300 refund from the merchant, which says the remaining $73 cannot be issued because of the bank dispute.

answer.issue: Disputed purchase refund not credited
answer.summary: The consumer says Citibank denied a dispute for undelivered charms, and the seller's agreed refund was not fully credited, leaving $73 outstanding.

answer.issue: Denied dispute for undelivered merchandise refund
answer.summary: The consumer is disputing a credit card charge after a merchant failed to deliver items and only partially refunded the purchase.

title: Mortgage balance grew during Covid forbearance
complaint: According to the CARES Act Mortgage Servicers or Lenders were not supposed to add additional interest or fees or penalties during an approved Forbearance period. Prior to Covid-19 my loan balance was around {$100000.00} - {$100000.00}. As of today XX/XX/2021 the loan balance increased to {$110000.00}. Why is Chase Bank adding additional dollars to my balance when they were not supposed to add any additional interest, fees or penalties during Forbearance period per CARES Act?

answer.issue: Loan balance increased during forbearance, possibly violating CARES Act
answer.summary: The consumer says Chase added about $10,000 to their mortgage balance during an approved forbearance period, which they believe the CARES Act prohibits.

answer.issue: Loan balance increased during forbearance
